consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance at the Portland Meadows show on May 28, 1995, was lackluster, with many noting Jerry Garcia's declining health and performance quality. While some moments were appreciated, the overall sentiment leans towards disappointment, especially compared to recent shows.
